## Requirements (Phase 0.3)
Deliverables:
1. records connector for non-US vocab — prefectural orders → LegalInstrument (instrument_type prefectoral_order / fr.arrete_prefectoral); internationalized records-request vocab incl. fr.cada & no_equivalent_available (NOT foia_request). §23.5,§13.8,SIG-ONTO-068.
2. procurement connector — national open-data dataset (DECP) → Contract, acquisition_channel / parent_cooperative_contract where relevant. §23.6, SIG-ONTO-032.
3. written study of ~12,000-camera OSM import — conventions, consultation, outcome — before any SIG-originated contribution at scale (SIG-CONTRIB-016).
4. France/Belgium jurisdictions, org types, legal-instrument types under national namespace (be.* added; NOT widening us.*).

Out of scope: adapter framework/BCP47/publication engine/coarse ingestion (P18.1); OSM contribution executed at scale (P16.2).

Requirement IDs to stamp: SIG-CHART-029, SIG-ONTO-068, SIG-ONTO-032, SIG-CONTRIB-016 + §11.14 LegalInstrument, §13.8 acquisition-method, §23.5/§23.6 connector ids.

## Key evidence (R9)
- DECP (F9.15/16): daily national procurement JSON, Licence Ouverte 2.0. Record shape: id, acheteur.id(SIRET buyer), titulaires[].titulaire.id(SIRET seller), montant(EUR), dateNotification(signed), dureeMois, modifications[](amendments), idAccordCadre(framework), procedure. maps 1:1 onto Contract.
- RAA préfectures (F9.18): 22,403 PDFs index CSV (ODbL); arrêté préfectoral = 5-yr renewable authorization; enacting body = préfecture; Code de la sécurité intérieure L251-1..L255-1.
- Ma Dada (F9.14): FR CADA FOI platform → fr.cada.
- Belgium (F9.31): declarationcamera.be register behind eID wall, not public → no_equivalent_available (known-complete-unknown). OSM import landed in Belgium first.
- OSM import (F9.6/7/8/12): sous-surveillance.net → OSM by User:Vucod + OSM Belgium; ~20k source / ~18k imported worldwide (~12k France subset); Brussels pilot 03/2020, full 03/2025; permission = one-line email (anti-pattern); join key ref:sous-surveillance_net; conflation <5m merge / 5-10m flag / >10m new; staleness flag >10yr. Outline's "12,000 + Technopolice attribution" imprecise — corrected here.
- Org types (F9.41): FR police_nationale/gendarmerie_nationale/police_municipale/douanes/prefecture; BE zones de police locale + police fédérale.

## Plan / design decisions
- New connector module `connectors/france_belgium.py` (US-shaped reuse avoided → proves no US assumption). Two registered connectors: `france_belgium_records`, `france_belgium_procurement`. Reuses country-neutral `procurement.Contract`.
- New `LegalInstrument` runtime shape (this ticket is first consumer; §11.14).
- New vocab data file `data/france_belgium_vocab.toml` (legal-instrument types + parents, acquisition methods, DECP procedure→channel map, sources), drift-tested vs ontology enums.
- Ontology `common.yaml`: add be.* to JurisdictionType/OrganizationType/LegalInstrumentType (+ any fr.* org gaps: fr.police_nationale, fr.gendarmerie_nationale, fr.douanes, fr.prefecture). Regenerate artifacts (verify-gen).
- BE adapter row in jurisdiction_adapters.toml + jurisdictions.toml publication (BE-GDPR redact-by-default). FR already seeded.
- OSM import study: prose docs/studies/osm-sous-surveillance-import.md + machine-readable data/osm_import_study.toml + gate `assert_import_studied_before_scaled_contribution` (module osm_import_study.py). Test the gate.
- New source rows: raa_prefectures, madada, declarationcamera_be.
- ADR-057; traceability + risk register updates.

## Test matrix (Phase 1.4)
- records: emits fr.cada (FR) / no_equivalent_available (BE), never foia_request/us.foia [AC1, deterministic]
- prefectural order → LegalInstrument instrument_type in prefectoral_order family [AC2]
- DECP record → procurement.Contract (buyer/seller/amount/dates; framework agreement → cooperative_piggyback + parent) [AC2]
- BE + FR org/legal/jurisdiction terms are <cc>.* under shared parent; no us.* widened; adapter validates [AC3]
- OSM import study documents conventions/consultation/outcome; gate refuses scaled contribution when unstudied [AC4]
- vocab↔ontology drift test; ontology verify-gen byte-clean; make check green [phase-gate]
